notes: Milling cutting rows come from the General Purpose End Mill chart (one chart for all general-purpose lines, not per coating); vc and fz are ranges [low, high]. The chart's diameter columns share their end points (e.g. 1/8 - 1/4 and 1/4 - 3/8), so a tool at a boundary gets rows for both columns.

The General Purpose chart PDF has a broken text layer for some labels (e.g. "%URQ]H", "6WDLQOHVV6WO 6RIW", "5F"); those labels were read from the rendered page: Bronze, Stainless Stl (Soft)/(Hard), High Tensile (25-45 Rc). Numbers are from the text layer and match the rendered page.
The drill speed/feed chart PDF is an image only; it was transcribed by eye from the rendered page.
No ap/ae is given in any Lakeshore chart.
